inputs.prompt: <Video 1> <Picture 1> <Picture 2> A quiet early-morning scene in a modest 1990s Chinese working-class home bedroom, pale cold daylight coming through white lace curtains, the room still and hushed after a loss. At the start of the shot, a little Chinese girl, around six years old with a black bob haircut and neat bangs, wearing a pale-yellow cotton jacket and grey-blue trousers, sits on the foot-edge of a neatly made bed; a single bright red hair ribbon lies on her lap. Her mother, a young Chinese woman in her late twenties with two neat low braids, wearing a clean indigo-blue cotton jacket, sits right beside her on the same bed edge. Over the course of the shot, in one slow continuous motion, the girl picks up the red ribbon with her left hand and slowly extends her arm toward her mother, offering it; her mother raises her right hand, gently takes the ribbon, then lowers it into her own lap and holds it with both hands, gazing down at it. From beginning to end both remain seated side by side on the bed edge - they do not stand up, do not walk, do not change seats; only their arms and hands move, slowly and gently, no sudden movement. The red ribbon is the only bright red object in the frame, vivid against the quiet muted room. Both characters have clear detailed faces exactly matching the reference portraits <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>. The bed with folded quilts rises behind them, a wooden nightstand with an alarm clock at the bedside, clean worn wooden floor. Refined watercolor concept-art animation style, delicate fine ink linework, loose transparent watercolor washes, granular cold-press paper texture, restrained indigo black denim-grey and cream palette, soft cold morning light, quiet intimate melancholic atmosphere, slow continuous camera push-in, gentle seamless motion.
